reviewer: coordinator; scientific changes chosen and authored by B author
original_issue: Positive exp(k*BMI) with shifted-lognormal BMI yields divergent moments. Typical finite draws do not remove this population moment defect.
change: Replace BMI exponent term in glycaemia mean links by 1+beta*(BMI-center), retaining coefficients as local relative derivatives. Age/sex exponent terms are bounded. No BMI ceiling.
moment_argument: BMI=16+exp(normal with bounded mean shift) has all finite positive polynomial moments. Given age/sex/component, glycaemic factors are lognormal with fixed finite component parameters. Multiplying by a linear BMI factor, a bounded age/sex multiplier and component indicators bounded by1 preserves all positive integer moments; additive lognormal meal increments also have finite moments. Independence of Gaussian residual draws from age/BMI, aside from bounded component selection, is specified in generator.
